What this app does

Instagram and YouTube open inside this app.

Stays open
• Home
• Messages
• Stories
• A normal YouTube video

A Reels page goes back to Instagram Home.
Search and Explore open your messages.
A Shorts page goes back to YouTube Home.

This app cannot see other apps. It does not read your screen and it does not tap buttons. Google Pay can stay on the phone.

Android phones only. This does not run on an iPhone.

Sign in once on the page that opens. Alerts from the website are weak. The normal Instagram app can stay installed for alerts. Open Instagram from here when you want Reels blocked.
Share app sends IG-Gate.apk. The other phone must be Android.
